import copy
def diff_summary(before, after):

targets = [('port',19,14), ('bar',20,23), ('gray tile TL',50,25), ('purple top',51,15)]
for name,r,c in targets:
    before = current_frame.ascii
    res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    d = diff_summary(before, current_frame.ascii)
    print(name, (r,c), "changed:", len(d), d[:12], {k:res.get(k) for k in ('done','level_completed','reward')})
    if res.get('done') or res.get('level_completed'): break
